[[Dockmaster Ahlaro]] runs [[Elona Docks]], and offers passage to [[Dajkah Inlet (outpost)|Dajkah Inlet]] after completing the [[Consulate Docks]] [[mission]]. This allows players to get to Dajkah Inlet without running to it, this is effective for low level players who want hero armor pieces.

==Dialogue==
Before completing the Consulate Docks mission:
:''"The other day I found a gold piece at my feet. The stars smile upon me."''
After completing the Consulate Docks mission:
:''"Ah, [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]]. The sun shines brightly on [[Elona]]. It's a good day for sea travel. A boat departs for the Dajkah Inlet soon. Will you be on it?"''
